proposedManifest.name: Professor X (Charles Xavier)
proposedManifest.description: Professor X's essential comics as Comic Book Herald's guide selects them, from Uncanny X-Men #12 through X-Men: Legacy #225. It keeps the guide's crucial issues from the Silver Age, the Claremont years and New X-Men, then Deadly Genesis, the Rise and Fall of the Shi'ar Empire, New Avengers: Illuminati and X-Men: Legacy, in the guide's order. Onslaught, Jonathan Hickman's Krakoa era and its 2024 finale continue on the Professor X and the X-Men path in Modern Timeline. In memory of Sir Patrick Stewart (1940 to 2026), who brought Professor X to life on screen.
proposedManifest.sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
